<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Preview for Croatia v Spain</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.101greatgoals.com/topic/croatia-football-team/" data-type="post_tag" data-id="267">Croatia</a> will attempt to recover from a record-breaking defeat when they welcome world champions <a href="https://www.101greatgoals.com/topic/spain-football-team/" data-type="post_tag" data-id="290">Spain </a>to Split in the <a href="https://www.uefa.com/uefanationsleague/" rel="nofollow noopener">UEFA Nations League</a> on Tuesday night.</p><div id="great-596859761" class="great-content-after-1st-paragraph great-entity-placement" style="margin-top: 10px;margin-bottom: 10px;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto;text-align: center;"><script async="async" src="https://securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/tag/js/gpt.js"></script>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Slaven Bilic’s side were <a href="https://www.101greatgoals.com/football/internationals/croatia-england-result-report-goals-highlights/" data-type="post" data-id="214597">thrashed 7-0 by England</a> on Saturday, while Spain maintained their perfect start to League A Group 3 with a 3-1 win over the Czech Republic.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Croatia could hardly have endured a more damaging evening when they welcomed England on Saturday.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">It was the heaviest defeat in Croatia’s history and the first time the national team had ever conceded five or more goals in a home match.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Croatia had begun the campaign positively with a 2-1 victory away against the Czech Republic, but successive defeats have left them third in Group 3 on three points.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">They are three points behind second-placed England and six adrift of Spain, while the Czech Republic remain bottom without a point.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Spain could scarcely be in better form.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Luis de la Fuente’s team have won each of their opening three Nations League matches, beginning with a 3-2 victory over England at Wembley before dismantling Croatia 4-1.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">La Roja then made it three wins from three by beating the Czech Republic 3-1 in Oviedo on Saturday.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Spain have now won 10 consecutive matches across all competitions and are unbeaten in their last 41 games.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">De la Fuente’s side are also unbeaten in 16 successive Nations League matches when penalty shootouts are excluded, representing the longest such sequence since the competition was introduced.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Team News for Croatia v Spain</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Croatia did at least emerge from the defeat to England without any significant new injury problems.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">However, Bilic has several selection decisions to make following the nature of Saturday’s performance.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Luka Vuskovic, Marco Pasalic, Josip Misic, Petar Sucic and Martin Pongracic are all at risk of suspension if they receive another booking.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Pongracic was not included in the matchday squad against England, while Lovro Majer, Ante Budimir and Dion Drena Beljo were also omitted.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Spain have no fresh concerns surrounding Yamal or Alex Baena after both were replaced at half-time against the Czech Republic, with the changes made for tactical reasons rather than because of injury.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Pau Cubarsi was rested completely on Saturday but should be available to return to the defence in Split.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">De la Fuente is already without Ferran Torres, Nico Williams and Alex Grimaldo after the trio withdrew from the squad.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Where to Watch Croatia v Spain: TV and online streams</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Croatia v Spain kicks off at 7:45pm BST on Tuesday, October 6 at the Stadion Poljud in Split. The match will be available to watch live in the UK through Amazon Prime Video on a pay-per-view basis.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Prediction for Croatia v Spain</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The last thing Croatia would have wanted after conceding seven goals against England is a meeting with a Spain side currently scoring freely against almost everyone they face.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Bilic should demand a far more disciplined performance after Saturday’s humiliation, and Croatia are unlikely to leave themselves quite as exposed as they did against the Three Lions.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Even so, their defensive problems are impossible to overlook. Spain scored four times in the reverse fixture and have now reached 10 goals after only three Nations League matches.</p>
